## Context

The draft taxonomy defines core observable concepts across orchestration, execution, protocol, and reasoning/context planes. It also maps those planes to the Agent Behavior Trace Model dimensions: execution structure, reasoning and planning, and outcomes and effects.

## Scope

Publish the taxonomy as a repository artifact and make the trace-model crosswalk explicit:

- define the taxonomy planes and core terms
- map planes to charter focus areas
- map planes to the Agent Behavior Trace Model dimensions
- preserve OpenTelemetry alignment guardrails
- identify terms that are AAIF extension concepts rather than replacements for existing OTel terms
- identify where ongoing coordination with the central AAIF Taxonomy/Landscape working group is required

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A taxonomy document exists in the repository.
- [ ] The document includes the plane model and trace-model crosswalk.
- [ ] The document clearly distinguishes conceptual planes from focus-group ownership.
- [ ] The document states the OpenTelemetry alignment guardrails.
- [ ] Dependencies or open questions for the central AAIF Taxonomy/Landscape working group are called out.
- [ ] The README links to the taxonomy.

## Notes

This should stay a taxonomy, not become a mini-specification. Normative field-level proposals should be tracked separately when the WG reaches that stage.
